name: ASBO Labs
changelog:
1.3.0-beta.1

  • Introduces the isolated ASBO Labs beta lane.
  • Adds the split desktop product-library/configurator workspace, three-step Items → Artwork → Checkout flow, and 10-second New here? helper.
  • Adds responsive mobile behavior and a concise artwork-planning experience.
  • Phase 1 is read-only against WooCommerce: no cart, order, artwork upload, stock or pricing writes.
